title: As Koreans eat less rice, CJ looks overseas to grow Hetbahn
caption:
Instant rice does not need chemical preservatives to survive on a pantry shelf. By milling grain hours before cooking and packaging it in semiconductor-grade cleanrooms, producers keep bowls fresh for nine months at room temperature.

Source: Koreaherald - As Koreans eat less rice, CJ looks overseas to grow Hetbahn
